$comment: Store screens in store order. Every screen is a real screen of the native DINCR app, captured on the synthetic STORE fixture; the templates never draw UI. `plan` is the lowest plan that includes the screen: the capture runs with it and the caption must carry its badge (copy/*.json). A platform may be used for finals only where `confirmed` is true: the screen was checked in that platform's code on origin/main and how_to_reach says how to open it. Audited on 2026-09-30 against origin/main 31b0310b (Android: #287, #292, #293; iOS: #294).

app_baseline.rule: Final images only from captures whose source commit contains this merge (the native app). Anything older shows the Capacitor UI and is refused.

store_release_gate.reason: The stores still ship the Capacitor app (native/RELEASE_IDENTITY.md). These images show the native app, so they may be uploaded only when Kenneth publishes the native build under the store identity. Nothing in this pipeline uploads.

fixture.android: Debug build, intent extras dincrFixtures=STORE, dincrPlan=<plan>, dincrSkipLogin=true, dincrLatencyMs=0 (native/android/core/data/.../StoreSample.kt). Captured by scripts/capture-android.mjs through the opt-in test app/src/androidTest/.../StoreScreenshots.kt.
fixture.ios: Debug build, launch arguments -DincrFixtures store -DincrPlan <plan> -DincrSkipLogin (FixtureBackend .store, native/ios/DincrKit/.../StoreSample.swift reading the bundled store-sample.json). Captured by the opt-in XCUITest DINCRUITests/StoreScreenshots.swift on a Mac (CAPTURE.md, MAC REQUIRED).
